summary: Xenia Hotels & Resorts filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $200 million of common stock under an Equity Distribution Agreement with multiple agents. The filing establishes a continuous offering program with forward sale agreements. No specific price, premium, or timeline is set. This is a routine capital-raising mechanism, not a special situation. The registrant is the issuer. Watch for actual sales and settlement terms, but no special-situation event is triggered.
